newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch flower exports rise 7.9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Dutch flower exports rise 7.9 pct in Sept.

text.p: The total value of Dutch exports of flowers and plants grew 7.9 percent in September to 564 million guilders, the Dutch Flower Export Council said.
In its monthly report, the council said total exports for the first three quarters of 1996 increased 8.7 percent to 5.4 billion guilders.

Council members which include most of the large Dutch plant and flower growing firms, reported more stable trade with East Europe. The council did not give specific figures but said sales to eastern Europe have been showing a gradual improvement throughout 1996.
The Council said French buyers were worthy of special mention as in the last nine months their purchases of Dutch cut flowers had risen 20 percent from last year to around 500 million guilders.
